## Scope and owner service

## Design impact
- [ ] No unapproved visual, copy, step-order or interaction change.
- [ ] `node scripts/check-design-reference.mjs` passes.
- [ ] For a UI implementation: reference/candidate/diff screenshots attached at the required sizes.
- [ ] Motion and reduced-motion, keyboard focus, back/edit/resume and repeat-booking verified.
- [ ] Cash, both QR methods, pending review, mismatch and before/after preserved.
- [ ] Any explicit design approval is linked; no silent snapshot replacement.
